notes.title: Dev Update - April 2025
notes.content:
Hey, y'all!

Work is still being made on Season 2, and we've been locked the hell in and hard at work with it.

We are sitting at a little over 1,700 images and 61 animations, up +700 renders and 28 animations from last month.

I'll go ahead and drop a few previews for the upcoming first Chapter of Season 2.
